description: This file defines an interface IPlacementDirector for placement strategies within the Orleans distributed framework. It specifies methods for selecting silos for grain activation, and includes a static helper method for retrieving placement hints from request context data.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Asynchronously determines an appropriate silo address for placing a grain activation based on the given placement strategy, target, and context.

methods.name: GetPlacementHint
methods.description: Static method that retrieves a placement hint address from request context data if present and valid, considering only compatible silos.
